contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.subtitle: Track and sign your farm contracts.
contracts.intro: On Monday, 12 May 2026, the parties agreed as follows:
contracts.clause1Body: The second party shall supply 50 tons of first-grade hard wheat to the first party, matching the specifications in Annex (A), at an average price of 5,000 EGP per ton.
contracts.clause2Body: Delivery shall be made to the first party's silos no later than 15 June 2026. The first party may reject any shipment that does not meet quality standards (moisture not exceeding 12%, free of impurities and pests).
contracts.clause3Body: Settlement is executed automatically via smart contracts on NileChain upon receipt and inspection confirmation by the first party. The total value (250,000 EGP) is deposited into the second party's linked bank account within 24 hours.

The only soft spot is the approaching expiry of the Global GAP certificate (two months remaining), which warrants follow-up but does not pose an immediate risk to current crop quality. Proceeding with contracting is advised, with a standard late-delivery penalty clause.

contractSign.title: Contract signing
contractSign.subtitle: Review terms and complete e-signatures.
contractSign.bismillah: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
contractSign.preamble: On Monday, 12 October 2026, this contract was executed between:
contractSign.partyBuyerBody: Nile Food Industries Co., headquartered in the Industrial Zone, 6th of October. Legally represented for signature by Mr. Ahmed Mahmoud.
contractSign.partySellerBody: Modern Delta Farms, agricultural registration no. 45992, located in Dakahlia Governorate. Legally represented by Mr. Mohamed Abdullah.
contractSign.clause1Body: The second party undertakes to supply yellow maize to the first party in a quantity of 500 metric tons, according to the following technical specifications validated by the automated conformity system:
contractSign.clause1Item4: Crop free of insect and fungal infestation.
contractSign.clause2Title: Article 2: Total value and payment method
contractSign.clause2Body: The parties agree that the price per ton is 15,000 EGP, bringing the total contract value to 7,500,000 Egyptian pounds (seven million five hundred thousand Egyptian pounds only). Payment shall be made in installments linked to the attached delivery schedule via the NileChain platform.
contractSign.clause3Body: Delivery shall be made to the first party’s warehouses within a maximum of 30 days from the date of signing this contract. In case of delay, a late penalty of 1% per week of delay applies to the delayed installment value. The first party may reject any shipment that does not meet the specifications in Article 1.
